title: ה'לא' ששומר על ה'כן'
theme: the no that guards your yes
emotional_truth: every 'no' you can say protects a 'yes' that matters more; a boundary is self-respect, not rejection

forbidden: using a boundary as a weapon or punishment
any 'no' meant to hurt rather than to protect
safety.notes: A boundary here is always kind and firm, never cold or cruel. Saying 'no' is self-respect, not rejection of the other person. Success is the attempt to honor your own limit, never the other person's reaction.
